# H anger is not a reason

## The heuristic

**"The customer is angry" is not an escalation reason. It is a symptom. The reason is whatever made them angry, and if you cannot write that down, escalating relocates the confusion rather than resolving it.**


_Why:_ Reasons stated as emotions cannot be acted on or refused, so receivers respond to the loudest description rather than the largest impact. Forcing the reason into a factual sentence is also the cheapest test of whether the escalation is ready.
